title: Deterministic AST-Level Command Authorization via execpolicy

claims.assertion: Command approval safety engines must tokenize shell syntax into AST prefix rules rather than relying on string matching or regexes

context: Prompting users for every trivial shell command creates approval fatigue, while auto-approving based on regexes allows trivial shell injection bypasses.
